item.title: Iowa cattlemen worried about Argentina beef executive order
item.description: A recent executive order from President Trump will see more beef coming into the U.S. with the goal of easing pressure on cattle farmers and keeping prices down. However, for beef farmers in Iowa, they aren't so sure the President's order will help.
